pat.cb.closed: {title}, which you heard of {ago}, came to its end.
pat.cb.cut: {title}, which you heard of {ago}, came to nothing.
pat.cb.advanced: {title}, which you heard of {ago}, goes on.
pat.age.hegemony: From {from} to {to} was the age of {court.name}, whose word ran through the valley.
pat.age.era: From {from} to {to} the valley lived in its {era}.
pat.war_won_by_dragon_act.title: the war {attacker.name} made on {defender.name}
pat.war_won_by_dragon_act.line: {defender.name} survived the war {attacker.name} began in {a.year}, because you came into it in {b.year}.
pat.war_won_by_dragon_act.line.held: {defender.name} held out against {attacker.name} until the war wore itself out in {c.year}, because you came into it in {b.year}.
pat.war_won_by_dragon_act.line.turned: {defender.name} turned the war {attacker.name} began in {a.year} and took land of its own, because you came into it in {b.year}.
pat.war_won_by_dragon_act.open: {attacker.name} went to war against {defender.name} in {a.year}, and you came into it in {b.year}.
pat.war_lost_to_dragon_fire.title: the war {attacker.name} made on {defender.name}
pat.war_lost_to_dragon_fire.line: {attacker.name} won its war on {defender.name} in {c.year}; your fire on {defender.name} in {b.year} had done half the work.
pat.war_lost_to_dragon_fire.open: {attacker.name} went to war against {defender.name} in {a.year}, and you fell on {defender.name} in {b.year}.
pat.vengeance_for_burning.title: the vengeance {court.name} swore for your fire
pat.vengeance_for_burning.line: {court.name} never forgave your fire of {a.year}: it founded a slayer order in {b.year}, and in {c.year} the order came for you.
pat.vengeance_for_burning.line.failed: {court.name} never forgave your fire of {a.year}: its slayers, sworn in {b.year}, came for you in {c.year} and failed.
pat.vengeance_for_burning.line.martyred: {court.name} never forgave your fire of {a.year}: its slayers, sworn in {b.year}, died at your lair, and in {c.year} the court named them martyrs.
pat.vengeance_for_burning.line.slew: {court.name} never forgave your fire of {a.year}: its slayers, sworn in {b.year}, killed you in {c.year}.
pat.vengeance_for_burning.line.marched: {court.name} never forgave your fire of {a.year}: its slayers, sworn in {b.year}, set out for your lair in {c.year}.
pat.vengeance_for_burning.open: {court.name} founded a slayer order in {b.year} to answer your fire of {a.year}.
pat.order_rise_and_fall.title: the slayer order of {court.name}
pat.order_rise_and_fall.line: The {nth}slayer order of {court.name}, founded in {a.year} and ready by {b.year}, met its end in {c.year}.
pat.order_rise_and_fall.line.failed: The {nth}slayer order of {court.name}, founded in {a.year} and ready by {b.year}, broke against you in {c.year}.
pat.order_rise_and_fall.line.slew: The {nth}slayer order of {court.name}, founded in {a.year} and ready by {b.year}, killed you in {c.year}.
pat.order_rise_and_fall.line.outlived: The {nth}slayer order of {court.name}, founded in {a.year}, outlived the court that made it.
pat.order_rise_and_fall.line.fell: The {nth}slayer order of {court.name}, ready by {b.year}, went down with its court in {c.year}.
pat.order_rise_and_fall.open: The slayer order {court.name} founded in {a.year} was ready by {b.year}.
pat.martyrs_remembered.title: the memory of the slayers of {court.name}
pat.martyrs_remembered.line: The slayers of {court.name} were gone, but {heir.name} took up their cause in {b.year}.
pat.martyrs_remembered.line.spread: The slayers of {court.name} were gone, but their cause spread to {heir.name} in {b.year}.
pat.grudge_to_answer.title: the grudge of {court.name}
pat.grudge_to_answer.line.mended: {court.name} held a grudge against you from {a.year}, until you stood by it in {d.year}.
pat.grudge_to_answer.line.armed: {court.name} held a grudge against you from {a.year}, and in {d.year} it armed slayers.
pat.grudge_to_answer.line.fell: {court.name} held a grudge against you from {a.year} until it fell in {d.year}.
pat.grudge_to_answer.open: {court.name} has sworn a grudge against you since {b.year}.
pat.oath_of_recovery.title: the oath {vower.name} swore
pat.oath_of_recovery.line: {vower.name} swore to win back what you took from {a.court} in {a.year}, and kept at it until {c.year}.
pat.oath_of_recovery.line.returned: {vower.name} swore to win back what you took from {a.court} in {a.year}; in {c.year} you gave it back.
pat.oath_of_recovery.line.died_unfulfill: {vower.name} swore to win back what you took from {a.court} in {a.year}, and died in {c.year} with the oath unkept.
pat.oath_of_recovery.line.thieves: {vower.name} swore to win back what you took from {a.court} in {a.year}; in {c.year} thieves climbed your mountain for it.
pat.oath_of_recovery.line.hunt: {vower.name} swore to win back what you took from {a.court} in {a.year}; in {c.year} the oath became a hunt.
pat.oath_of_recovery.open: {vower.name} has sworn to win back what you took from {a.court} in {a.year}.
pat.prophecy_answered.title: the prophecy of {court.name}
pat.prophecy_answered.line: {court.name} read a prophecy in {a.year}; in {c.year} it said you had fulfilled it.
pat.prophecy_answered.line.fire: {court.name} read a prophecy of fire in {a.year}; your fire of {b.year} fulfilled it.
pat.prophecy_answered.line.grace: {court.name} read a prophecy in {a.year}; your grace of {b.year} fulfilled it.
pat.prophecy_answered.open: {court.name} read a prophecy about you in {a.year}.
pat.hostage_raised.title: the life of {person.name}
pat.hostage_raised.line: {person.name}, taken from {court.name} in {a.year} and raised in your lair, came to a turn in {c.year}.
pat.hostage_raised.line.ruled: {person.name}, taken from {court.name} in {a.year} and raised in your lair, ruled {court.name} from {c.year}.
pat.hostage_raised.line.died: {person.name}, taken from {court.name} in {a.year} and raised in your lair, died in {c.year}.
pat.hostage_raised.open: {person.name}, taken from {court.name} in {a.year}, has grown up in your lair.
pat.ruler_slain.title: the death of {ruler.name}
pat.ruler_slain.line.crisis: You killed {ruler.name} of {court.name} in {a.year}, and the throne was fought over by {c.year}.
pat.ruler_slain.line.fell: You killed {ruler.name} of {court.name} in {a.year}, and by {c.year} the realm had broken apart.
pat.burned_to_waste.title: the burning of {region.name}
pat.burned_to_waste.line: You burned {region.name} in {a.year} until it was waste.
pat.burned_to_waste.line.orcs: You burned {region.name} to waste by {b.year}, and in {c.year} orcs came to live in the ash.
pat.burned_to_waste.line.resettled: You burned {region.name} to waste by {b.year}; in {c.year} people settled there again.
pat.burned_to_waste.line.haunted: You burned {region.name} to waste by {b.year}; in {c.year} its dead would not lie still.
pat.burned_to_waste.open: Your fire of {a.year} left {region.name} a waste in {b.year}.
pat.the_fading.title: the fading of {court.name}
pat.the_fading.line: The fading of {court.name}, begun in {a.year}, ended in {b.year}.
pat.the_fading.line.sailed: The fading of {court.name}, begun in {a.year}, ended in {b.year} when the elves left the valley.
pat.the_fading.line.recovered: The fading of {court.name}, begun in {a.year}, lifted in {b.year}.
pat.the_fading.line.fell: The fading of {court.name}, begun in {a.year}, ended with its fall in {b.year}.
pat.sack_and_revenge.title: the sack of the capital of {loser.name}
pat.sack_and_revenge.line: {winner.name} sacked the capital of {loser.name} in {a.year}; in {c.year} the debt was paid back.
pat.sack_and_revenge.line.fell: {winner.name} sacked the capital of {loser.name} in {a.year} and fell itself in {c.year}.
pat.sack_and_revenge.open: {winner.name} sacked the capital of {loser.name} in {a.year}, and revenge was sworn in {b.year}.
pat.treasure_hunt.title: the treasure hunters of {court.name}
pat.treasure_hunt.line: Treasure hunters of {court.name} came for your hoard in {b.year}; in {c.year} you answered.
pat.treasure_hunt.line.fire: Treasure hunters of {court.name} came for your hoard in {b.year}; in {c.year} you burned their city.
pat.treasure_hunt.line.robbed_again: Treasure hunters of {court.name} came for your hoard in {b.year}; in {c.year} you robbed the court again.
pat.tyrant_falls.title: the tyranny in {court.name}
pat.tyrant_falls.line: The {nth}tyrant of {court.name}, risen in {a.year}, died in {b.year}.
pat.tyrant_falls.line.fell: The {nth}tyrant of {court.name}, risen in {a.year}, died in {b.year}, and the realm fell apart in {c.year}.
pat.tyrant_falls.line.crisis: The {nth}tyrant of {court.name} died in {b.year}, and the throne was fought over by {c.year}.
pat.tyrant_falls.line.thaw: The {nth}tyrant of {court.name} died in {b.year}, and a golden age began in {c.year}.
pat.plague_war.title: the war that followed the plague in {court.name}
pat.plague_war.line: Plague weakened {court.name} in {a.year}; {enemy.name} went to war on it in {b.year}, and the war ended in {c.year}.
pat.plague_war.line.conquered: Plague weakened {court.name} in {a.year}; {enemy.name} went to war on it in {b.year} and took land by {c.year}.
pat.succession_war.title: the succession war of {court.name}
pat.succession_war.line: The throne of {court.name} was disputed in {a.year}; {claimant.name} fought for it from {b.year} to {c.year}.
pat.succession_war.line.won: The throne of {court.name} was disputed in {a.year}; {claimant.name} fought for it and won in {c.year}.
pat.hegemony_arc.title: the hegemony of {court.name}
pat.hegemony_arc.line.revolt: {court.name} ruled the valley from {a.year}, until its vassals rose in {b.year} and the hegemony ended in {c.year}.
pat.hegemony_arc.line.coalition: {court.name} ruled the valley from {a.year}, until the others joined against it in {b.year}; it ended in {c.year}.
pat.hegemony_arc.line.dragon: {court.name} ruled the valley from {a.year}, until you fell on it in {b.year}; its hegemony ended in {c.year}.
pat.dragon_broke_hegemon.title: the fall of {court.name}
pat.dragon_broke_hegemon.line: You broke the hegemony of {court.name}, and in {b.year} the realm itself went down.
pat.dragon_broke_hegemon.line.bent: You broke the hegemony of {court.name}, and in {b.year} it knelt to another court.
pat.temple_to_the_dragon.title: the temple {court.name} raised to you
pat.temple_to_the_dragon.line: {court.name} raised a temple to you in {b.year}, after your help of {a.year}.
pat.temple_to_the_dragon.line.betrayed: {court.name} raised a temple to you in {b.year}, and in {c.year} you fell on its city anyway.
pat.temple_to_the_dragon.line.blessed: {court.name} raised a temple to you in {b.year}, and in {c.year} you stood by it again.
pat.temple_to_the_dragon.line.fell: {court.name} raised a temple to you in {b.year}; the court fell in {c.year}.
pat.temple_to_the_dragon.open: {court.name} raised a temple to you in {b.year}.
pat.debt_of_the_saved.title: the debt {court.name} owed you
pat.debt_of_the_saved.line: {court.name} remembered that you saved it in its war, and in {b.year} it showed it.
pat.debt_of_the_saved.line.tribute: {court.name} remembered that you saved it in its war, and in {b.year} it sent tribute.
pat.debt_of_the_saved.line.temple: {court.name} remembered that you saved it in its war, and in {b.year} it raised you a temple.
pat.debt_of_the_saved.line.feast: {court.name} remembered that you saved it in its war, and in {b.year} it held a feast in your name.
pat.debt_of_the_saved.line.ingratitude: You saved {court.name} in its war, and by {b.year} it was arming against you.
pat.golden_age_burned.title: the golden age of {court.name}
pat.golden_age_burned.line: {court.name} was in its golden age when you came in {b.year}; by {c.year} it was over.
pat.golden_age_burned.line.fell: {court.name} was in its golden age when you came in {b.year}; by {c.year} the realm had fallen.
pat.fall_after_defeat.title: the fall of {court.name}
pat.fall_after_defeat.line: {court.name} lost its war in {a.year} and broke apart in {b.year}; {heir.name} rose from the pieces.
pat.exiles_return.title: the exile from {region.name}
pat.exiles_return.line: The people driven from {region.name} in {a.year} saw it lived in again by {b.year}.
pat.exiles_return.line.home: The people driven from {region.name} in {a.year} came home in {b.year}.
pat.exiles_return.line.others: The people driven from {region.name} in {a.year} never came back; others took it in {b.year}.
pat.last_of_their_kind.title: the last of a people
pat.last_of_their_kind.line: The {race.name} remnant of the valley, left since {a.year}, was gone by {b.year}.

pat.war_lost_to_dragon_fire.cb.cut: You fell on {defender.name} in the middle of its war {ago}; it came through the war all the same.

pat.martyrs_remembered.open: The slayers of {court.name} were gone, but their memory was kept.

pat.prophecy_answered.cb.cut: The prophecy of {court.name}, which you heard of {ago}, was never fulfilled.
pat.hostage_raised.cb.cut: Nothing more was heard of {person.name}, whom you raised.
pat.burned_to_waste.cb.cut: {region.name}, the waste you made, lay as it was.
pat.sack_and_revenge.cb.cut: The revenge sworn for the sack of {loser.name}, which you heard of {ago}, came to nothing.

pat.treasure_hunt.cb.cut: You never answered the treasure hunters of {court.name}.
pat.tyrant_falls.open: The {nth}tyrant of {court.name}, risen in {a.year}, died in {b.year}.
pat.tyrant_falls.cb.cut: The tyrant's death in {court.name}, which you heard of {ago}, changed little.

pat.succession_war.open: The throne of {court.name} was disputed in {a.year}, and {claimant.name} went to war for it in {b.year}.
pat.hegemony_arc.cb.cut: The hegemony of {court.name}, which you heard of {ago}, held.

pat.exiles_return.open: The people of {court.name} were driven from {region.name} in {a.year}.
pat.last_of_their_kind.open: The {race.name} of the valley have been a remnant since {a.year}.
pat.the_fading.cb.cut: The fading of {court.name}, which you heard of {ago}, goes on unseen.
pat.grudge_to_answer.cb.cut: The grudge of {court.name}, which you heard of {ago}, faded.
